title: Sub-kilometre feasibility Phase 3: dependence-aware validation of the 3 percent windage finding
scope: Leave-one-track-out and purged forward-time validation of the windage coefficient chosen in the sweep.
summary: The 3 percent finding only partially held up. Under leave-one-track-out, 3 percent was selected on all four training folds, and on held-out tracks it beat persistence in 9 of 16 meaningful horizon cells and causal velocity in 3 of 4 meaningful 48 h cells. Under a purged forward-time split, the fit period selected 2 percent, and on the later test period it beat persistence in 0 of 4 cells and causal velocity in 0 of 1.

metrics.name: LOTO held-out cells beating persistence
metrics.provenance: Out of 16 meaningful cells (at least 10 cases).

metrics.name: LOTO held-out 48 h cells beating causal velocity
Forward-time 48 h cells beating causal velocity

limitations: All four tracks are one July-August 2018 deployment episode near Puerto Rico; rolling cases overlap heavily, so case counts are not independent samples.
Forcing is retrospective reanalysis (daily-mean currents, hourly reanalysis wind), not an as-issued forecast.
No 500 m or sub-kilometre positional skill and no St Kitts validation is claimed; final claims require another deployment.
Provider track metadata has unresolved caveats, so no period is treated as confirmed.
Leave-one-track-out folds share one deployment event and are not independent replications; a forward-time split of the same event is not independent either.
Both schemes are exploratory diagnostics, not confirmatory validation.

evidence.summary: Verdict fields of the validation results file; the sweep medians reproduce the sweep file exactly.
